intro: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak is a night elf guardian stationed within the serene groves of the Oracle Glade on Teldrassil. Charged with monitoring the sacred balance of the northern boughs, she keeps a wary watch over the glade's enchanted waters and woodland wildlife.

p: Arynia Cloudsbreak serves the Sentinel army in one of the most secluded and mystical reaches of Teldrassil: the Oracle Glade. Amid ancient trees and ethereal springs, she carries out her watch far from the bustling avenues of Darnassus, ensuring the sanctity of the wilderness remains undisturbed.

Despite Teldrassil's sacred birth, creeping disharmony has begun to unsettle its creatures. Arynia relies on passing adventurers and young night elves to investigate local disruptions, such as strange behaviors among the glade's wildlife and mystical phenomena around the enchanted springs.
